name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: The official rulebook and sample add-ons for building extensions to the Cursor AI code editor.
buyer: A developer-tools startup that wants its product listed as an official Cursor plugin to reach Cursor's user base.
business_use_cases: A devtools company builds a Cursor plugin for their product (e.g. a linter or API client) to get discovered by millions of Cursor users.
An agency builds custom internal Cursor plugins for enterprise clients to wire proprietary codegen rules into engineers' editors.
A trainer creates and sells a 'build your first Cursor plugin' course referencing this spec.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche Cursor plugin (e.g. compliance linting) and monetize via a paid tier inside the plugin.

steal_this: Pick one annoying manual workflow you repeat in Cursor and ship it as a tiny free plugin this weekend to build an audience, then upsell a pro version.
